name: search_text
description: Line-oriented search of text files in the workspace for lines matching a regular expression. Returns matches with their file path and 1-based line number. Searches all searchable files unless paths are given. Large files without newlines are scanned in overlapping segments, and matches on very long lines report a bounded context snippet rather than the whole line; returned match text is capped at 2,000 characters, with a trailing ellipsis when truncated. On very long lines, matches longer than the 64 KiB segment overlap, or greedy matches that span an overlap boundary, may behave differently or be missed. This is NOT a binary search tool: files containing NUL bytes are skipped in directory walks, and an explicitly named binary file returns an error. Use run_shell with strings or grep -a to search binary files.

detailed: Searches text files for lines matching a regular expression.
whimsical: Dig up the words you seek.

detailed: tool {participantRole} is searching file contents for a pattern

pattern.description: Regular expression to match against each line.

paths.description: Optional list of workspace-relative paths to search. A path may be a file or a directory (searched recursively). If omitted, the whole workspace is searched.
